lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is a double-header on September 30th around the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W. Pacific — Town Council convenes a special session to hear an appeal of the P&Z-approved lot consolidation, while HARC holds its own special meeting to work through preliminary design review on all the proposed buildings. Layered on top of that, the County is taking a serious look at an Employee Housing Impact Fee in a work session Wednesday, and Town Council sits down Thursday to sketch out the 2027 General Fund budget. On the lighter side, Pink Talking Fish hits the Sheridan Friday and the Annual San Miguel River Cleanup is Saturday.

notable.stake: HARC votes on preliminary design for all Carhenge building clusters.
Council hears appeal that could reverse or uphold the Carhenge lot consolidation.
County weighs a new Employee Housing Impact Fee affecting future development countywide.
Public hearing on vesting extension; ALPR camera debate raises real privacy questions.
